purpose: Independent simulated beginner mouse-only Rill usability report; visible observations only.
persona: Simulated first-time beginner interested in a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Instrument assignment, chord generation, naming, save and export were achievable by mouse. Numeric dragging and the moving generator buttons required trial and correction.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark layout, teal waveforms, note previews and clear text labels look coherent and readable. It felt polished visually, though much of the workspace is empty for a small sketch.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Most clicks and edits responded promptly. WAV export displayed an elapsed timer, and a playback failure plus recovery slowed the session. Tool and screenshot overhead is not a software benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Moderate confusion: clicking a number exposed text editing without explaining dragging; Add notes moved after the first addition; Duplicate selected a tool rather than immediately copying; WAV progress was displaced by a MIDI notice.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: The visible app provided audio clips, a native VST3 instrument, generated MIDI chords, volume controls, mouse naming, project saving, WAV and MIDI export. This covers this sketch; broader DAW features and other plugins were not evaluated.

findings.observation: The empty-area Double-click for MIDI instruction led directly to the Device library. Assign instrument added Rill Lab Sine and a new MIDI clip.
Generate offered visible chord previews and root/chord choices. The completed pattern visibly contains four successive chord sections.
Clicking Length selected a text value; scrolling did not change it. Horizontal dragging changed the numeric value, but this mouse interaction was not obvious from the field.

After adding the first chord, a status line moved Add notes and Next range downward. Clicks at the former Add notes position missed; Fit initially showed only the first chord. Reopening the generator and clicking the lower button added the missing sections.
Selecting Duplicate alone made no copy. Tool help explained clicking a clip; doing that created adjacent drum copies.
Dragging the last audio edge toward the MIDI end first produced a 30.536-second arrangement. A second trim left the project at 30.000 seconds, with the audio visually ending slightly before the MIDI.
Initial playback activated meters, then stopped at transport 002.01.61 with Audio output stream failed or disconnected. Error details showed ALSA snd_pcm_avail_delay and I/O error (5).
After dismissing the error and using Stop, Start and Play, the playhead advanced into bars 6 and 9 with both track meters active. No audio was auditioned.
Rename project exposed a clickable Keyboard. Its Clear, letters and Space controls entered rain room entirely with the mouse; Save inherited the name.
Exporting MIDI while the WAV result was still unconfirmed replaced the visible bottom status with the MIDI success notice. Re-export last WAV provided a later unambiguous WAV success notice.
The UI displayed Arrangement 0:30 in WAV export, allowed effect tails to be unchecked, and ultimately showed success notices for both MIDI and WAV.

outcome.status: Completed in the visible UI: named and saved a 30-second audio-plus-VST-MIDI arrangement and saw WAV and MIDI export success notices. Files require independent verification.
outcome.composition: 112 BPM, 4/4. Starting Circuit rhythm audio duplicated into four clips, with the last trimmed to near the end. One MIDI clip contains sustained C minor, F minor, G minor and C minor triads in 4, 4, 4 and 2-bar sections. Drums set to -12 dB and instrument to -13.2 dB. Intended as a simple relaxed sketch; audible style unverified.
outcome.playback_observed: Initially meters activated, then playback stopped with an audio-output-stream error at 002.01.61. After Stop/Start/Play, screenshots show playback at 006.02.14 and 009.03.57 with both track meters active. Playback was stopped before saving; no full uninterrupted pass was verified.

limitations: No composition file contents were inspected and no audio was heard or auditioned; independent coordinator verification follows.
Observed playback failure occurred in the specified software-graphics, timer-paced virtual-audio laboratory. It does not establish physical-hardware latency or reliability.
Only the installed Rill Lab Sine instrument was used; other third-party plugins were not evaluated.
Screenshot filenames 11-midi-30-seconds.png and 32-wav-complete.png describe premature intentions; their visible contents and this report are authoritative.
Elapsed session time includes screenshot, tool and report overhead and is not a performance benchmark.
